```gitignore
# ==========================================
# Cline Ignore Rules
# Reduce unnecessary file scanning and token usage
# ==========================================

# Dependencies
node_modules/
**/node_modules/

# Build output
dist/
**/dist/
build/
**/build/
out/
**/out/

# Astro generated files
.astro/
**/.astro/

# Framework and tool caches
.cache/
**/.cache/
.vite/
**/.vite/
.turbo/
**/.turbo/
.next/
**/.next/
.nuxt/
**/.nuxt/
.vercel/
**/.vercel/

# Test and coverage output
coverage/
**/coverage/
playwright-report/
**/playwright-report/
test-results/
**/test-results/

# Generated search indexes
pagefind/
**/pagefind/
public/pagefind/
public/search-index/

# Logs
*.log
npm-debug.log*
pnpm-debug.log*
yarn-debug.log*
yarn-error.log*

# Environment files
.env
.env.local
.env.*.local
!.env.example

# Temporary files
*.tmp
*.temp
*.bak
*.swp

# OS files
.DS_Store
Thumbs.db

# IDE files
.vscode/
!.vscode/extensions.json
!.vscode/settings.json
.idea/
```
